Name: Immersive Sprinklers and Scarecrows
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[i][b]This mod replaces both my Immersive Sprinklers and Immersive Scarecrows mods - objects placed using those mods will not work with this mod. This mod is better.[/b][/i]

With this mod you can place sprinklers and scarecrows directly onto tilled soil tiles. They will be placed on the corner closest to the mouse cursor and water or protect crops surrounding them. Placing requires a mouse.

Immersive objects can be passed through by the farmer.

To remove an immersive object, hover over it and press the pickup key (default [b]E[/b]).  You can enable removing an object very close to the farmer in the config (automatically enabled for Android). You can also use a pickaxe to remove objects.

You can swap the sprinkler or scarecrow at any junction with another by placing it at the same junction.

You can check a sprinkler or scarecrow range by hovering over it and holding down the show range key (default [b]Left Ctrl[/b] for sprinklers and [b]Right Ctrl[/b] for scarecrows).

By default:

[list]
[*][b]Ordinary sprinklers[/b] will water all [b]four[/b] surrounding tiles.[/*]
[*][b]Quality sprinklers[/b] will water the [b]sixteen[/b] tiles surrounding the sprinkler.[/*]
[*][b]Iridium sprinklers[/b] will water the [b]thirty-six[/b] tiles surrounding the sprinkler.[/*]
[/list]
You can change the sprinkler radii for these or any custom sprinkler in the config.

Sprinklers can hold both an enricher and a pressure nozzle.

You can manually activate a sprinkler by hovering over it and pressing the activate key (default [b]Enter[/b]). You can enable activating all sprinklers close to the farmer in the config (automatically enabled for Android); you can change the range for this or set it to 0 to activate all sprinklers in the current location.

You can show all ranges at once by holding down the show all range key (default [b]Right Alt[/b])

You can change object scale, opacity, and position in the config.


[b][size=5]Notes[/size][/b]

Radii will be affected by mods that change radius or add objects with custom radii. Modded objects with different range shapes or mechanics will not work with immersive scarecrows.

[b]Objects are now stored in GameLocation mod data, so will be unaffected by removal of hoe dirt.[/b]


[size=5][b]Config[/b][/size]

You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].


[b][size=5]Technical[/size][/b]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
